players.product: AI colocation in retrofit data centers (NC-1 North Carolina 40 MW IT leased to Nscale; MTL-3 Montreal for Cerebras) plus GPU cloud services on NVIDIA B300 / Vera Rubin clusters

quarterly_data.signal: WhiteFiber's 8-K: on August 16, 2026 its subsidiary Enovum Data Centers agreed to buy two industrial properties in Yadkin County, North Carolina (about 55 miles from NC-1) from Unifi Manufacturing, to be retrofitted into data center campuses NC-2 and NC-3. Each property is expected to be served with a minimum of 30 megawatts of gross power, a combined minimum of 60 MW of initial gross utility capacity, with up to an additional 69 MW per property within seven years after closing (a potential combined maximum of up to 198 megawatts), subject to confirmation as a closing condition. WhiteFiber targets initial ready-for-service capacity in the third quarter of 2027, has received non-binding letters of intent with investment-grade credit support from prospective customers, and expects closing in the fourth quarter of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: NC-2 / NC-3: 60 MW initial gross capacity, up to 198 megawatts potential; initial ready for service Q3 2027 (target)
